episodes.synopsis: Children unwittingly reopen an ancient battle between Autobots and Decepticons.
episodes.title: First Encounter (1)

episodes.synopsis: Alex, Rad and Carlos find the cargo hold of the Exodus underground and are adopted by three minicons.
episodes.title: Metamorphosis (2)

episodes.synopsis: Alexis, Rad and Carlos introduce themselves to Optimus Prime, Hot Rod and First Aid.
episodes.title: Base (3)

episodes.synopsis: The children join the Autobot team and head out on their first mission to find a newly waking minicon.
episodes.title: Comrade

episodes.synopsis: Autobots discover a MiniCon at the South Pole.
episodes.title: Soldier

episodes.synopsis: The newest minicon activates in the middle of a forest: both sides fight for it.
episodes.title: Jungle

episodes.synopsis: Rad and Carlos smuggle their minicons out of the base to visit the town's carnival.
episodes.title: Carnival

episodes.synopsis: In an ancient palace deep beneath the Sahara another minicon is waking. Who will reach it first?
episodes.title: Palace

episodes.synopsis: The Decepticons capture all the children to use as hostages in exchange for the Autobots's minicons.
episodes.title: Confrontation

episodes.synopsis: The latest minicon re-activates in the subway system of a large city.
episodes.title: Underground

episodes.synopsis: From an ancient submerged city a beautiful girl issues a warning about the devastating power.
episodes.title: Ruin

episodes.synopsis: The children learn more about the history of the minicons and the war.
episodes.title: Prehistory

episodes.synopsis: The Decepticons gain access to the Autobot base and attempt to take the other two minicons.
episodes.title: Swoop

episodes.synopsis: Hot Shot proves himself very skilled with the Star Sabre.
episodes.title: Overmatch

episodes.synopsis: A new minicon activates inside a highway tunnel.
episodes.title: Gale

episodes.synopsis: Grabbing onto Megatron at the end of a battle, Hot Shot and Sideways are transported to the moon.
episodes.title: Credulous

episodes.synopsis: Decepticons mutiny while searching for MiniCons in a jungle.
episodes.title: Conspiracy

episodes.synopsis: Autobots and Decepticons face off amongst snowy mountains in the battle for the latest minicon.
episodes.title: Trust

episodes.synopsis: A weekend's camping trip to the valley below the dam goes wrong when a violent storm moves in.
episodes.title: Vacation

episodes.synopsis: Autobot Blurr joins the team, but proves himself not much of a team player.
episodes.title: Reinforcement

episodes.synopsis: Megatron plots to destroy the Autobots once and for all.
episodes.title: Decisive Battle

episodes.synopsis: Megatron uses the Minicons to lure the Autobots into a trap.
episodes.title: Vow

episodes.synopsis: Starscream challenges Megatron for control of the Decepitcons.
episodes.title: Rebellion

episodes.synopsis: Trapped with Sideways, Alexis, Rad, Carlos and their minicons become aware of a massive evil entity.
episodes.title: Chase

episodes.synopsis: A new transformer enters the solar system.
episodes.title: Tactician

episodes.synopsis: With Optimus damaged and temporarily out of commission, the newly-arrived Jetfire takes command.
episodes.title: Link Up

episodes.synopsis: On the moon, Thrust continues his plotting with Megatron.
episodes.title: Detection

episodes.synopsis: The massive Tidalwave joins the Decepticons, but is, seemingly, defeated in battle by Hot Shot and Blurr.
episodes.title: Awakening

episodes.synopsis: The kids try to gather the three Requiem Blaster minicons together.
episodes.title: Desperate

episodes.synopsis: The minicons want to be in charge of their own destinies, so the kids sneak the new team out of the base.
episodes.title: Runaway

episodes.synopsis: Enthusiastic young Sideswipe joins the team and Optimus tasks Hot Shot with training him.
episodes.title: Past (1)

episodes.synopsis: Desperate to make amends to his old friend, Hot Shot allows Wheeljack to shoot him, but this isn't enough.
episodes.title: Past (2)

episodes.synopsis: Megatron sacrifices Starscream, leaving him to face the Autobots alone.
episodes.title: Sacrifice

episodes.synopsis: Hearing Megatron say he is nothing more than disposable cannon fodder, Starscream defects with the Star Sabre.
episodes.title: Regeneration

episodes.synopsis: With Starscream's help, the Autobots infiltrate the Decepticon moon base.
episodes.title: Rescue

episodes.synopsis: Alexis tracks a minicon in the vicinity of Mars.
episodes.title: Mars

episodes.synopsis: Starscream trusts Thrust and returns to the moon base.
episodes.title: Crack

episodes.synopsis: Sabre, Shield and Blaster together create the Hydra Cannon.
episodes.title: Threaten

episodes.synopsis: Optimus and Jetfire attack the ship, but can't stop the Hydra Cannon being deployed.
episodes.title: Crisis

episodes.synopsis: Hot Shot insists they should take vengeance on the Decepticons.
episodes.title: Remorse

episodes.synopsis: With the Autobot ship ready to leave, Hot Shot refuses to let the children accompany them.
episodes.title: Depart

episodes.synopsis: While the Axalon chases the Decepticon ship, hundreds of minicons appear.
episodes.title: Miracle

episodes.synopsis: Hot Shot and Red Alert are sucked through a wormhole.
episodes.title: Puppet

episodes.synopsis: The 'Bots reach Cybertron to find Megatron (now calling himself Galvatron) already winning the war.
episodes.title: Uprising

episodes.synopsis: While the battle continues, Hot Shot goes to Cybertron to try to convince Galvatron of the impending danger.
episodes.title: Dash

episodes.synopsis: Thrust flees into the depths of Cybertron, pursued by Hot Shot and Wheeljack - and, separately, Starscream.
episodes.title: Drift

episodes.synopsis: Thrust joins Sideways by passing through a portal underground.
episodes.title: Portent

episodes.synopsis: Starscream prepares to do whatever it takes to convince Galvatron the threat of Unicron is real.
episodes.title: Cramp

episodes.synopsis: As Unicron begins to awaken, Optimus and Galvatron decide to forgo their battle.
episodes.title: Alliance

episodes.synopsis: The only way to defeat Unicron is to wake the minicons inside him and attack from within as well as without.
episodes.title: Union (1)

episodes.synopsis: The purpose and meaning behind the endless war is revealed.
episodes.title: Origin (2)

episodes.synopsis: Thinking Unicron is defeated, Galvatron and Optimus Prime resume their battle.
episodes.title: Mortal Combat (3)
